title: An entity reference is its character: Replace <version> & tag it.
head: 2613716adf515ad3bee46acf5cb26110cc3a8324

clause.text: An entity reference in the body is its character, as on GitHub (CommonMark's entity and numeric character references): `Replace <version> & tag it.` reads "Replace <version> & tag it."

scenes.caption: code-style's SKILL.md says "Replace <version> & tag it.": it reads "Replace <version> & tag it."
Any HTML5 name, a decimal or a hex reference: "© 2026 — issue #88 ✓" is "© 2026 — issue #88 ✓"

clause.text: code point 0, past U+10FFFF or a surrogate → U+FFFD

scenes.caption: Code point 0, one past U+10FFFF and a surrogate are each the replacement character, �

clause.text: an unknown name, or no `;`, as typed

scenes.caption: An unknown name, or one with no ;, reads as typed: "AT&T &nosuch; &amp more"

clause.text: in text, a link's text and its destination, and a bare URL

scenes.caption: In a link's text and its destination, and in a bare URL: "<docs>" links to ?a=1&b=2, the bare URL is ?x=1&y=2

clause.text: not in code, nor after a backslash

scenes.caption: In code, and after a backslash, & stays as typed

clause.text: the character is text, never Markdown nor HTML

scenes.caption: The character is text: "*not italic* <b>bold?</b>" has no italics and no bold, only text
